no diurnal variation, not associated with cold, cough,\u0026nbsp; burning micturition.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o pain abdomen which was squeezing type with insidious onset, gradually progressive with no aggravating and relieving factors.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o anorexia and nausea present.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o vomitings\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAlso Pt C\/o pain over Lt LL associated with Itching and swelling which is insidious in onset and gradually progressive.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/c\/o HTN since 10 years( not on regular medication)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/c\/o filariasis to Lt LL since 45 years\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EN\/k\/c\/o DM2, TB, Epilepsy,CAD,CVA, Hypothyroid.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite decreased\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep Normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder movements regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddictions none\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn General examination:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt is oriented to person\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot oriented to time and place, moderately built and nourished.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Pallor, icterus,clubbing, cyanosis,lymphadenopathy\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELeft lower limb discoloration and edema\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVitals:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP: 90\/60 mmhg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPR: 96bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPR: 20 cpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECVS: S1 S2 +\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERS: NVBS+ BLAE+\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EP\/A: Diffuse Tenderness Present\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; INJ. LEVIPIL 1gm IV\/BD given for 16 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2. INJ NORAD @1.1 ml\/hr for 7 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3. INJ DOBUTAMINE IV for 7 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E4. INJ VASOPRESSIN @5 ml\/hr for 6 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E5. INJ THIAMINE for 7 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E9. INJ HAI for 16 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E10. INJ PIPTAZ 2.25 gm IV TID for 5 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E11. TAB ATORVASTATIN + ASPIRIN 75 mg RT\/HS\u0026nbsp; for 16 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E12. TAB. OROFER XT PO OD for 16 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E13. Nebulisation with IPRAVANT 6th hourly and BUDECORT 4th hourly for 16 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E14. INJ MEROPENEM 500 mg IV BD for 12 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E15. TAB. FLUCONAZOLE 150 mg RT OD for 8 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E16. INJ VANCOMYCIN 500 mg IV BD for 5 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E17. Change of position 2nd hourly and daily dressing of bed sore\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECOURSE IN THE HOSPITAL:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 55 year old male with L5(unstable) burst fracture (3 weeks old ) and was transferred from orthopaedics to General medicine i\/v\/o high GRBS . Patient sugars were controlled with insulin infusion and handed over to orthopaedics. After 1 hr patient developed Altered sensorium and transferred to GM . Altered sensorium was thought to be due to hyponatremia was corrected with 3% NaCl.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENext day i\/v\/o falling saturation , patient was intubated. He also had bradycardia at that time and CPR was initiated and patient relieved. As breath sounds decreased on Right side of Chest ,HRCT CHEST was done .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient developed Heart Failure with 44% Ejection Fraction, D-dimer was found to be elevated initially , pulmonary embolism was suspected and HEPARIN was added to the treatment. Patient had hypotension and was put on inotrope support. As there were raised counts and fever spikes in between, antibiotics were started.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient had decreased urine output and increased Serum Urea and Serum Creatinine. Diuretics were added to the treatment and gradually urine output increased. He was maintained on Ventilator and triple inotrope support. His blood pressure improved gradually and gradually inotrope suport was weaned off. Patient had recurrent episodes of seizures in between and was controlled with antiepileptics.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn 6\/9\/23, patient was tracheostomised and\u0026nbsp; maintained on Ventilator.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDue to low Hb levels 1 PRBC transfusion was done on 12\/9\/23.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESepsis was resolving gradually and antibiotics were de escalated gradually.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOxygen support was tapered and patient was maintaining on room air on 14\/9\/23.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn 16\/9\/23, at around 2 am patient was again connected to Oxygen support i\/v\/o falling saturation and maintained on it for 2 hours and around 5 am patient had falling saturation even with high flow oxygen support and had bradycardia.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAt around 5 am CPR was started and continued for 30 mins. Inspite of efforts, patient expired .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"replies","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/chetanaketarollno74.blogspot.com\/feeds\/3803478638045626796\/comments\/default","title":"Post Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient\/ attender was informed the purpose of the information being acquired. An informed consent was taken from patient\/ attender and there is omission of information that was requested to be omitted.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECONSENT WAS GIVEN BY BOTH PATIENT AND ATTENDER\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EChief complaints:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 60 yr old female,homemaker who is a resident of Nalgonda came with chief complaints of cold and cough since 10 days, fever since 10 days .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 10 days ago then she had cough and cold, aggravated with cold climate and relieved with medication. Cough is productive,whitish, non foul smelling and persistent.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o watery nasal discharge, on and off, aggravated with cold climate and relieved with medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFever is of low grade, intermittent, not associated with chills and rigors.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPast history:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/c\/o HTN since 20 yrs and is on medication ( Aten 25)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EN\/k\/c\/o DM,TB,Asthma,CVA,CAD,Epilepsy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDaily routine:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe wakes up at 5 am and does her chores like cleaning and mopping the house and by 8 am ,she freshens up and has breakfast and then washes clothes. After that she cooks food have lunch by 12 pm. After that she takes nap and does other activities like gardening, going to market etc and by 7 pm she takes dinner . She then sleeps by 9 pm.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn examination:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is conscious and coherent, well oriented to time,place and person.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo pallor,icterus,cyanosis, clubbing,lymphadenopathy or edema\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVitals:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfebrile\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP: 120\/80 mm Hg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPR: 64 bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECVS: S1,S2+, no murmurs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERS: BLAE+, No added sounds\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECNS: NFND\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPA :Soft and non tender\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
